agreements: All 29 proposal context paths match their declared SHA-256 values, and the exact change, both registered interpretations, and critique validate through the generic intake chain. Structural validity does not establish substantive executable closure.

PPC5 remains a narrow four-prerequisite causal instrument: D1A concerns supported complete-table candidate selection, D1B concerns observable public response-path dependence, D1C concerns a frozen DREAM context policy, and D1D concerns the total root-to-SLEEP policy. It is not a flywheel, continual-learning, learned-THINK, learned-DREAM, private-cognition, parenting, population-learning, inheritance, compression, or scaling experiment.

The intended population is only the accepted-constructible recipient-bundle law of the exact locked generator. One independently generated recipient-life/common-seed bundle is the equal-weight unit; lower queries, items, endpoints, calls, edges, and observation rows are repeated measurements and never increase N.

The five candidate/release strings in change.json are byte-identical to claim_dependency_map.json, the Holm family contains exactly the four registered component claim IDs, and the four-way intersection adds no fifth hypothesis. These exact literals and the existing accepted-constructible qualification must be preserved in the successor.

The proposal materially repairs earlier bytes: the visibility table contains the exact ordered 13 by 15 product with 195 unique cells; transition_cause_registry.json contains the seven intended cause classes; controller result vocabulary removes CONSTRUCTION_FAIL and TERMINAL as ordinary results; and T01 intentionally has no PPC fixture or PPC TEST_RESULT.

The schema generator does recursively resolve local $defs with cycle detection, all 142 top-level schema object types are inventoried, and an independent target check finds no typed artifact reference to an absent inventoried type. The broader systems claim that local recursive resolution is absent is rejected; the narrower inventory, replay-retention, and visibility-role defects remain blocking.

The direct-paired intervention intent, failure-as-adverse rule, per-edge CUT/TWIN/SHAM design, frozen THINK/DREAM/ACT boundary, READ-only adapter write, descriptive resource accounting, exact rational inference, and non-mediational claim boundary are scientifically coherent and must be retained.

The frozen r8 bytes do not close controller terminal behavior, pre-entropy temporal authority, life-level aggregation, per-life D1A controls, D1B emitted-byte causality, common-seed replay, joint construction-and-release power, exact fixture universes, or an acyclic T13-to-ratification-to-authority chain. Those defects can change execution, inference, or release authority and cannot be filled by post-ratification implementation choices.

Current authority remains NONE_PROPOSAL_ONLY. Registering this REWORK consensus may move the generic intake from awaiting_consensus to human_required, but implementation_authorized remains false and the generic release-blocker logic makes these exact r8 bytes technically non-ratifiable.

No PPC implementation, fixture authoring or execution, static sealing, model/tokenizer/embedding dispatch, training, canary, CPU behavioral run, GPU action, scientific run, claim, or release is authorized by this consensus. Only authoring a finite corrected successor proposal and repeating fresh interpretation, critique, consensus, and human review is permitted.

disagreements.issue: The exact schemas disagree on the post-third-error count, and row-level queue effects permit D1B EQ_2 error branches to terminalize with outstanding or newly queued work lacking one final disposition.

positions.position: Treat the third error as ERROR_LIMIT and rely on semantic queue coverage and a promised terminal discard to make the machine total.
The public/private counter bytes and every result-specific queue effect must be schema-identical and every terminal path must close all queued slots before terminal state.

resolution.rationale: The reviewer position controls. public_view_body currently permits only 0..2, private_controller_receipt permits 0..3, and every EQ_2 ERROR transition increments; D1B_ONE_PLAN, D1B_OPEN_PLAN, D1B_OPEN_BLIND_PREDICT, and D1B_OPEN_BLIND_ACT also inherit row-level QUEUE while going directly to ERROR_LIMIT. This resolves SYS-A01 by selecting a terminal consecutive_error_count of exactly 3 in both public and private terminal receipts; only nonterminal pre-dispatch states admit 0..2.
resolution.selected_position: Represent the third consecutive error as count 3 in both public and private terminal bytes, move queue_effect into each result_transition, and route every branch with outstanding queued slots through a deterministic typed queue-finalization phase before terminal state.
resolution.required_change: In PPC5r9, set public and private counter schemas to the same 0..3 domain, require input count 0..2 for any dispatch row, and require EQ_2 ERROR plus INCREMENT to emit terminal count 3 and normalized ERROR_LIMIT. Remove controller_row.queue_effect and add a required result_transition.queue_effect. ERROR and missing branches may not QUEUE a request or commitment. Add FINALIZE_QUEUE as a no-model phase: on any terminal intent with outstanding QUEUED slots, emit one ordered QUEUE_DISCARD transition and typed QUEUE_EFFECT_RECEIPT per outstanding slot, then emit exactly one HARNESS_TERMINAL transition; already FLUSHED or DISCARDED slots are untouched and REJECTED slots receive no effect. Direct terminal is allowed only when the outstanding set is empty. Freeze the complete reachable assay/program/index/guard/result/status/input-count/output-count/queue-state universe and reject zero or multiple transitions, direct terminal with outstanding work, duplicate effects, or uncovered slots.

disagreements.issue: T01 declares intake.state.json as its evidence artifact while requiring argv, process exit, and stdout bytes that neither generic consensus path persists and that the direct deliberation path does not even produce as a consensus CLI transcript.

positions.position: Keep exact command, exit-code, and stdout requirements and later bind them in an ARCHITECTURE_INTAKE_HISTORY object without a PPC producer.
Either first authorize a separate generic intake transcript feature or narrow T01 to the exact generic state/history bytes that are actually persisted.

resolution.rationale: The narrow option is selected and resolves SYS-A02 without expanding this proposal into a generic-tool implementation. record_consensus persists the consensus artifact hash, source-state hash value, unique transition, successor phase, flags, and artifact set; it does not persist argv, exit status, or stdout. architecture_deliberation calls record_consensus directly, so a consensus CLI transcript is not universal evidence.
resolution.selected_position: PPC5r9 T01 will attest only the generic intake fields and transition history that the bound generic code actually persists; command, exit-code, stdout-byte, and atomic transcript claims are removed.
resolution.required_change: Replace PPC5R8_T01 with PPC5R9_T01. Its sole evidence is the registered generic intake.state.json validated by the bound generic intake code: change_id matches; phase is human_required; human_required=true; implementation_authorized=false; architecture_change, both exact interpretations, critique, and consensus occur once; the sole awaiting_consensus->human_required history entry contains the predecessor source_state_sha256 value and the exact consensus artifact SHA-256; no architecture_human_ratification or PPC fixture/result/implementation/sealer artifact key exists. State explicitly that T01 does not prove or retain the invoking argv, process exit code, stdout bytes, or a deliberation-runner CLI transcript. Remove consensus_command_bytes, exit_code, stdout_bytes, stdout_ok, and any ARCHITECTURE_HISTORY_BINDER producer obligation from the PPC contract; later locks may bind the exact generic intake state artifact only.

disagreements.issue: A POPULATED_RUN_LOCK that contains realized life samples cannot prove that gate membership and D1A safety-trial choices were fixed before the entropy that generates their final identities, and bare fixed_before_entropy booleans provide no temporal ancestry.

positions.position: Use fixed_before_entropy=true in membership and safety registries, then include realized samples in one populated run lock.
Split a typed design lock from entropy acquisition, generated samples, deterministic key resolution, and the later populated run lock.

resolution.rationale: The split temporal DAG is required. It resolves SYS-A03 by distinguishing membership commitment from realization and resolves SCI_A01 by selecting ordinal safety-key templates before entropy and deterministically resolving them afterward.
resolution.selected_position: Create one self-hashed PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK, then typed entropy acquisition, proposal/life realization, resolved safety keys, and only then a POPULATED_RUN_LOCK.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must inventory and schema PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK, ENTROPY_ACQUISITION_RECEIPT, and RESOLVED_D1A_SAFETY_TRIAL_REGISTRY. The design lock freezes generator/source/parameter law, proposal limit, N, ordinal gate memberships, stable D1B gate keys, complete lower-unit key templates, D1A safety templates by sample ordinal/arm/endpoint/lower-unit ordinal, margins, pi0, ceilings, alpha, CP scale, capacities, budgets, call schedule, seed domains, and dispatch plan. ENTROPY_ACQUISITION_RECEIPT consumes that lock and binds all disjoint entropy slices before proposal decoding. Every proposal trace and LIFE_SAMPLE_RECEIPT consumes the design lock and entropy receipt. The resolved safety registry consumes the design templates plus all realized life/sample identities and proves exact one-to-one template resolution with no content or outcome choice. POPULATED_RUN_LOCK consumes all four layers and their exact set equalities. The sole authority order is PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK -> entropy -> proposals/life samples -> resolved safety keys -> POPULATED_RUN_LOCK -> T02..T12/seals/review -> T13 -> HUMAN_RUN_RATIFICATION_RECEIPT -> PRE_MODEL_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT; any back edge, self-attested timing boolean, or entropy predecessor omission fails.

positions.position: Authorize post-ratification fixture authors to populate generic manifest fields under prose coverage rules.
The proposal bytes being ratified must already determine every finite case, mutation, cardinality, expected output or first failure, and completeness oracle.

resolution.rationale: The reviewer position controls. A later fixture implementation may execute a normative universe but may not define it after exact-byte approval.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze complete finite generator specifications and exact axis registries, counts, branch-key unions, expected-result maps, and independent equality oracles for each PPC5r9 T02-T14 before fresh intake; fully materialized rows are also acceptable if identical to that specification.
resolution.required_change: For each PPC5R9_T02 through PPC5R9_T14, add a unique versioned generator contract with canonical iteration order, finite typed axis registries, applicability/exclusion rules, exact expected positive count, exact one-field mutation dimensions and count, exact branch-key encoding, and exact output bytes or first-failure code. Bind two independently implemented enumerators: one constructs the normative expected set from axes and one extracts the materialized executed set; PASS requires byte-set equality and count equality with zero missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, or mismatched rows. Replace caller-selected symbol/bytes fields and generic completeness_proof blobs with schema constants or typed closed registries. Freeze all these normative bytes before architecture ratification; post-ratification code may only materialize and execute them.

disagreements.issue: Several authority-bearing semantic registries are referenced as BYTE_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST, and ALLOWED_DISPATCH_REGISTRY and AUTHORITY_REGISTRY have no top-level typed object schemas.

resolution.selected_position: Use unique closed types for all semantic registries named by the run lock, seals, preflight, tests, authority, and release.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must populate one self-hashed typed object for CONTROLLER_REGISTRY, TRANSITION_CAUSE_REGISTRY, STATUS_REGISTRY, VISIBILITY_REGISTRY, GATE_REGISTRY, EVIDENCE_ROLE_REGISTRY, DEPENDENCY_REGISTRY, CLAIM_REGISTRY, RESOURCE_REGISTRY, OBJECT_INVENTORY_REGISTRY, CONTRACT_SCHEMA_REGISTRY, ALLOWED_DISPATCH_REGISTRY, and AUTHORITY_REGISTRY. Each schema fixes contract/type, run or architecture binding as applicable, producer, consumers, ordered row keys, role, ordinal, cardinality, referenced content hash, and self hash. Raw source trees, executable bytes, prompts, renderers, and blobs may remain byte manifests only under distinct raw roles that confer no semantic type by themselves.

disagreements.issue: The systems interpretation combines an incorrect claim that local schema recursion is absent with correct findings that MODEL_VIEW lacks cold-replay retention, all 83 allowed visibility tokens are detached from real ingress/projection roles, and the equality check compares two products of one generator data structure.

positions.position: The generator stops at local typed reference objects and therefore does not recursively traverse the schema.
Local $defs recursion exists and all typed target types are inventoried, but an independent edge witness, cold-replay MODEL_VIEW retention, and concrete visibility-to-schema role equality are absent.

resolution.rationale: The exact-byte cross-critique is selected. collect_typed_refs recursively resolves local $defs with active-stack cycle detection and memoization; the 142 top-level inventory has zero typed target types absent. However, MODEL_VIEW has only MODEL_DISPATCH:MODEL_VIEW, and none of the 83 VISIBILITY_<hash> allowlist values equals any inventory reference role.
resolution.selected_position: Preserve recursive local-ref traversal but repair replay retention, make every allowed visibility cell name a real typed ingress or projection edge, and compare schema, inventory, and visibility edge tables using independent derivations.
resolution.required_change: In PPC5r9, add COLD_REPLAY:MODEL_VIEW as an exact consumer binding or add one typed COMPLETE_MODEL_VIEW_MANIFEST whose ordered entries equal all dispatched views and which both replays consume. Replace every VISIBILITY_<hash> token with a registered concrete role naming one exact source type/field path, pure projection algorithm, output type/field path, consumer stage, ordinal, and cardinality; forbidden cells remain null. Produce three canonical edge sets independently from contracts.schema.json, object_inventory.json, and visibility_contract.json using separately source-hashed extractors, and require exact equality where visibility permits an ingress/projection plus explicit exclusions for audit-only edges. T12 must mutate every omitted, extra, swapped, wrong-stage, wrong-field, wrong-role, and stale edge.

disagreements.issue: D1B requires emitted response bytes to affect the next THINK view, yet the matrix forbids all RESOLVED_RESPONSE_BYTES influence at THINK while PRIVATE_CONTROLLER_RECEIPT directly consumes the privileged-stage projection; audit and opaque-commitment typing is also incomplete.

positions.position: Forbid resolved response bytes at THINK while allowing the private controller to hold RESOLVED_RESPONSE_PROJECTION and use one mixed PROVIDER_AUDIT union plus a 64-hex commitment.

Only the actually emitted public bytes may reach later THINK through the public state; all route, condition, source, match, nonce, and mapping information remains privileged, and controller ingress is emission-only.

resolution.rationale: The second position identifies the intended causal intervention while preserving noninterference. A D1B treatment cannot affect behavior if its public emission is forbidden from influencing subsequent model input, and direct controller access to the pre-emission projection bypasses the claimed boundary.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the ordered 13 by 15 visibility product, but make RESOLVED_RESPONSE_BYTES/THINK derived_only through one typed emitted-public-byte path and remove all projection, route, and mapping access from the controller.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must change the RESOLVED_RESPONSE_BYTES/THINK cell to derived_only with the exact role INTERVENTION_EMISSION_TO_PUBLIC_VIEW and register the sole path INTERVENTION_EMISSION_RECEIPT.emitted_public_bytes -> public_view_body.last_read -> MODEL_VIEW. Remove PRIVATE_CONTROLLER_RECEIPT.restricted_projection_ref and CONTROLLER:RESTRICTED_PROJECTION; if the controller needs response completion, give it exactly one typed INTERVENTION_EMISSION_RECEIPT ref containing no privileged metadata. Split cold-replay and release evidence into route_lineage_audit_refs containing only ROUTE_LINEAGE_AUDIT_RECEIPT and provider_audit_refs containing only PROVIDER_AUDIT_RECEIPT, with counts exactly equal to the applicable executed routes/provider calls. Add a privileged OPAQUE_LINEAGE_ALLOCATION_RECEIPT consuming a dedicated 32-byte entropy slice and recording the domain-separated SHA-256 commitment algorithm and canonical preimage; expose only the opaque handle/commitment to projection, emission, controller, state, and model. T03/T04/T08/T10/T12/T14 must show that changing emitted public bytes can change later THINK while holding route metadata fixed, and that changing condition, source, match keys, provider scores, nonce, or mapping while holding the allowed emission fixed cannot change restricted ingress, outputs, debit, status, or timing class.

disagreements.issue: MODEL_DISPATCH_RECEIPT records a bare seed integer rather than the preassigned run/life/sample/call seed entry and the inventory does not retain MODEL_VIEW for cold replay.

positions.position: A bare seed plus run/life/sample/call fields and the dispatch-to-view reference can be reconciled by semantic validation.
The dispatch must consume one exact typed common-seed entry and life sample, and replays must retain the complete ordered model-view sequence.

resolution.rationale: The second position is required. Exact identity fields do not prove that the integer came from the locked common-seed bundle, and dispatch ancestry alone does not require the view set to be present in both replay packages.
resolution.selected_position: Add a self-hashed common-seed entry receipt and life-sample edge to every model dispatch and require exact ordered view retention in both cold replays.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must inventory COMMON_SEED_ENTRY_RECEIPT with run_id, recipient_life_id, sample_ordinal, call_role, call_ordinal, seed, parent COMMON_SEED_BUNDLE ref, SEED_DERIVATION_RECEIPT ref, and self hash. Add a COMPLETE_MODEL_VIEW_MANIFEST ordered by run/life/sample/step/call whose membership equals all MODEL_DISPATCH_RECEIPT.model_view_ref values, and require it in each cold replay. Enforce identical run, life, sample, call role/ordinal, state body, ledger head, renderer, input bytes/tokens, model/tokenizer/prompt/adapter, output bytes/tokens/status, debit, envelope, transition, and post-state closure; mutate every field in T03/T08/T09/T10/T12/T14.

disagreements.issue: T13 says it verifies exact run ratification while HUMAN_RUN_RATIFICATION_RECEIPT requires T13, and PRECLAIM_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT names the same final T14 result twice under two fields.

positions.position: Include run ratification in T13 coverage, let ratification consume T13, and let preclaim authority carry both predecessor_receipt_ref and t14_test_result_ref to the same result.

T13 can validate the complete pre-model technical package without consuming the later human decision; the human receipt then binds T13, and PRE_MODEL authority binds both. A predecessor field is not a reason to duplicate the T14 edge.
resolution.selected_position: Use PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK -> construction/run lock -> T02..T12/seals/review -> T13 -> human run ratification -> PRE_MODEL authority; later use runtime reduction -> candidate decisions -> two cold replays -> one final T14 -> one preclaim authority edge -> release.
resolution.required_change: Remove exact run ratification and PRE_MODEL_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT from PPC5R9_T13 inputs, fixtures, evidence, and coverage. T13 must pass only after the populated run lock, exact registries, T02-T12, two seals and independence, fresh passing review, non-overriding advocate, conditional power, pointwise joint construction-and-release power, and all preflight-denial/topology checks pass. HUMAN_RUN_RATIFICATION_RECEIPT then consumes T13 exactly once plus the exact run package and human evidence. PRE_MODEL_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT consumes that human receipt and T13 exactly once and alone makes model execution reachable. Require a reference-level topological validator over exact hashes and reject duplicate aliases, back edges, release or authority input to T14, and optional-audit ancestry.

disagreements.issue: The proposal declares one equal-weight paired value per recipient life, but gate_observation_ref selects one treatment and one control OBSERVATION while each life membership may contain multiple lower_unit_ids; no typed object proves complete within-life reduction.

positions.position: Use semantic validators to interpret gate_observation_ref as the already aggregated life value despite its OBSERVATION targets.
Add a typed per-gate, per-life aggregate that consumes all and only the prospectively assigned lower units in both arms and emits one paired value and missingness result.

resolution.rationale: The scientific position controls. LIFE_SAMPLE_RECEIPT.gate_memberships carries lower_unit_ids through membership_entry, but the current paired result can still reference one lower-unit OBSERVATION and assert a paired difference. That permits pseudoreplication or favorable lower-unit selection.
resolution.selected_position: Introduce a closed LIFE_GATE_AGGREGATE for each gate_id and sample_ordinal and make it the sole statistical input unit.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must inventory LIFE_GATE_AGGREGATE with run, generator, PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK membership, LIFE_SAMPLE_RECEIPT, gate_id, sample_ordinal, recipient_life_id, endpoint, expected ordered lower_unit_ids, exact treatment and control condition roles, complete ordered OBSERVATION refs for each arm, coverage receipt, fixed equal-weight reduction algorithm, treatment aggregate, control aggregate, paired_difference, Z_i, missing flag, first failure, and self hash. Expected and observed lower-unit keys must be exactly equal in both arms; any absent, invalid, duplicated, extra, swapped, wrong-life, wrong-gate, or cross-run observation makes paired_difference null, Z_i=0, and the appropriate missing event, unless it is an integrity blocker that blocks the assay. PAIRED_GATE_RESULT must consume exactly one aggregate for each distinct prospectively assigned sample ordinal and define N as that count; raw observations, rows, calls, items, or edges cannot independently enter N. Bind aggregates through complete-life, endpoint coverage, power, seals, replays, authority, and release.

disagreements.issue: D1A_CONTROL_SET_RECEIPT describes one triple of origin/corpus controls with no sample ordinal or recipient-life identity, while the N-life run lock, power, seals, replay, authority, and release bind only one such receipt.

positions.position: One downstream D1A_CONTROL_SET_RECEIPT can stand for the run-wide controls.
Every D1A member requires its own recipient-specific authentic/wrong-life/binding-deranged control set, collected in an exact manifest equal to membership.

resolution.rationale: The second position is necessary for the recipient-life estimand. A singleton control receipt cannot establish matching and disjointness for every independent life.
resolution.selected_position: Add sample/life identity to each D1A control set and bind exactly one complete set per D1A sample ordinal in a canonical D1A_CONTROL_SET_MANIFEST.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must extend D1A_CONTROL_SET_RECEIPT with run_id, sample_ordinal, recipient_life_id, matching LIFE_SAMPLE_RECEIPT, and the exact D1A membership entry while retaining the ordered AUTHENTIC/WRONG_LIFE/BINDING_DERANGED origins, corpora, match proof, derangement proof, and dose/opportunity proof. Add D1A_CONTROL_SET_MANIFEST with entries ordered by sample ordinal, exact one-to-one equality to all and only D1A gate members and accepted life samples, no duplicate recipient or donor substitution, and a self hash. Replace every singular d1a_control_set_ref in POPULATED_RUN_LOCK, construction support/power, static seals, T06/T11/T13/T14, cold replay, premodel/preclaim authority, dependency, and release objects with the manifest or the exact per-life entry appropriate to that object.

disagreements.issue: Construction support points contain raw byte refs, asserted predicate booleans, and an inline conditional-power rational, while the overall receipt multiplies a construction bound by one global POWER_RECEIPT not shown to be conditional under the same successful-construction law.

positions.position: Multiply a certified construction-success lower bound by the realized locked run's conditional complete-release POWER_RECEIPT and label the product a chain-rule lower bound.

positions.actor: systems interpreter, scientific interpreter, and critic
positions.position: Bind construction facts and applicable release power pointwise under the same complete fresh-run construction law, or prove a uniform conditional lower bound over every successful point.

resolution.rationale: The pointwise construction is selected. A chain-rule label does not make an unrelated global conditional-power receipt a lower bound under the successful-construction mixture, and the current support point can assert its decisive booleans and rational without typed ancestry.
resolution.selected_position: Compute the unconditional complete-release lower bound by exact pointwise mass integration over the complete N-life prospective construction law, with failed and uncovered mass contributing zero.
resolution.required_change: PPC5r9 must replace the current support point with a typed COMPLETE_RUN_CONSTRUCTION_SUPPORT_POINT representing all N sample ordinals and their bounded proposal traces under the PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK. Each point consumes exact RECIPIENT_BUNDLE, DONOR_BUNDLE, DECODED_PROPOSAL, ordered ACCEPTANCE_PREDICATE_RESULT and first-failure/exhaustion receipts, path constructions, the per-life D1A_CONTROL_SET_MANIFEST entries, overlap construction, generator law, and both static seals. Each successful point consumes its own typed CONDITIONAL_COMPLETE_RELEASE_POWER_RESULT computed for that exact constructed gate/path/control/membership configuration. The finite proof computes L_joint = sum_s mass_s * I(construction_succeeds_s) * L_release_given_s in exact reduced rational arithmetic. The conservative-partition proof uses certified lower masses and per-partition lower power bounds with all uncovered or failed mass set to zero. Remove substitution of a single realized/global POWER_RECEIPT and remove product authority unless it is merely an algebraic rendering of the exact pointwise sum. T02/T06/T11/T13/T14 must reject wrong law, support omission/duplication/order, mass, predicate, exhaustion, D1A manifest, seal, conditional-power, construction identity, arithmetic, and threshold bindings.
